english.notes:
(i) The prosecution does not have to prove that the photograph or film mentioned in the threat exists or, if it does exist, that it is in fact a photograph of film showing or appearing to show a person in an intimate state, section 66B(7) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003.
(ii) Three other offences are available under section 66B and the following offence documents: H101570 - Sharing photograph or film of person in intimate state without consent; H101571 - Sharing photograph or film of person in intimate state intending to cause alarm distress or humiliation; H101572 - Sharing photograph or film of person in intimate state for the purpose of sexual gratification.(iii) Section 66C provides for exemptions to the offences under this section.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction may be 6 or 12 months depending on the general limit in a magistrates’ court, see section 66B(10) of this Act and section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2022.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
